items.t: Voted no on the redistricting effort in the South Carolina Senate and argued against it.
items.q: “We are the most gerrymandered Republican state in the country already,” South Carolina Senate Majority Leader Shane Massey (R), who voted against redistricting, argued in the state capitol.

items.t: Said that redistricting would diminish South Carolina's influence.
items.q: South Carolina has always punched above their weight," Massey said. "Doing this will diminish that influence.

items.t: Said lawmakers need to be held to a higher standard.
